title: Review typed human excitatory and inhibitory dynamics
objective: Review the public E/I design and propose the smallest biologically grounded implementation slice with exact CPU/CUDA parity gates.
acceptance: Separate genuine intrinsic cell families from signed homogeneous sources.
Specify exact parity, activity, capability, and anti-overfit gates.

title: Audit the direct cell-to-program decoder seam
objective: Inspect the public decoder design and identify one end-to-end implementation slice that cannot choose algorithms outside the cell race.
acceptance: Give a bounded interface and a test that detects non-cell selection.
Use only public train and development material.

title: Audit the next exact GPU scaling bottleneck
objective: Profile only the public synthetic simulation path and propose a measured change that increases useful active-cell throughput without weakening GLIF5 lifecycle semantics.
acceptance: Report active, updated, spiking, materialized, and addressable counts separately.
Require bit-exact CPU/CUDA lifecycle parity before accepting speed.
